r2.speaker: narrator
r2.text: The Master's hands were shaking. Not with age. With hunger.

r3.speaker: monk
r3.text: Eighteen winters I waited. Banished from the light with my whole order, cursed to rot in this temple between pages. I could not cross. But a child raised here... could.

r4.speaker: monk
r4.text: The 'thieves' you cut down were wardens. Each world's protector. Their light kept the dark out. Kept ME out.

r5.speaker: narrator
r5.text: The noh mask cracked down the middle. Behind it, something red, horned, and crowned in gold.

r6.speaker: monk
r6.text: The seal is broken. Thank you, my son.

choices.text: Was any of it real? The years? My name?
Then I am yours. I have nothing else.

r_real.speaker: monk
r_real.text: Real enough to sharpen. That is all a blade needs.

r_end.speaker: monk
r_end.text: Now give me the last light. Yours.
r_end.text_low_hope: There is so little left in you. It will barely hurt.
